Small airport. Big community. ✈️

In Loris, South Carolina, pilots, airport businesses and neighbors are rallying to keep Twin City Airport (5J9) flying.

General Aviation News reports that local mayors, flight instructors and state aviation officials are backing efforts to find a sustainable future for this small-town airfield. South Carolina Aeronautics has asked the county to keep it open while a statewide airport study moves forward, and says assistance is available for pavement maintenance.

Its future is still unresolved: county airport officials have not announced a reversal of the closure plan, and funding questions remain.

But the people who fly, teach and turn wrenches here are showing what general aviation looks like on the ground—a community working to protect its connection to the sky. 💛

Source: William Walker, General Aviation News, October 27, 2026.
